guides.facebook:
1. Nghena eka akhawunti ya wena ya Meta Business / Developers.
2. Endla Page Access Token ni mpfumelelo wa pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopa Page ID ya wena (eka About/Settings ra Page) ni token laha hansi.
guides.x:
1. Nghena eka developer.x.com u pfula app ya wena.
2. Endla OAuth 2.0 user access token ni scope ya tweet.write.
3. Nghenisa token laha hansi.
guides.linkedin:
1. Nghena eka linkedin.com/developers u pfula app ya wena.
2. Kuma access token ni scope ya w_member_social.
3. Nghenisa author URN ya wena (urn:li:person:XXXX) ni token laha hansi.
guides.instagram:
1. Instagram ya wena yi fanele ku va akhawunti ya Business leyi hlanganisiweke ni Facebook Page.
2. Kuma token ni mpfumelelo wa instagram_content_publish.
3. Nghenisa Instagram user ID ya wena ni token laha hansi.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Veka WhatsApp Cloud API eka Meta.
2. Kopa access token ya wena leyi nga heriki.
3. Nghenisa nomboro ya riqingho ya muamukeri (ni khodi ya tiko) ni token laha hansi.

ext_hint.facebook: Facebook Page ID ya wena (tinomboro ntsena)

skills_levy.what_this_is: Muholo wu hakela xibalo xa ku hluvukisa vuswikoti n'hweti ni n'hweti ni EMP201. Xiphemu xin'we eka ntlhanu xa xona xi nga tlheriseriwa tanihi mpfuno lowu bohaka, kambe ntsena hi mutirhisi loyi a rhumelaka Pulani ya Vuswikoti ya Ndhawu ya Ntirho ku nga si fika hi 30 Dzivamisoko.

councils.description: Swibalo swa huvo, mpimo lowu swi hlayiwaka ha wona, ni leswaku swi funengeta vatirhi vahi.
councils.how_it_works: Xibalo xi humesiwa eka muholo wun'wana ni wun'wana wa vatirhi lava huvo yi va funengetaka, kutani xi hakeriwa ni nyikelo wa mutirhisi. Vuxaka i hi munhu ha un'we: mutirhisi un'we hi ntolovelo u ni vatirhi lava funengetiweke ni lava nga funengetiwangi eka muholo wun'we.
councils.beneficiary_hint: Mali leyi nga eka xikirini xa tihakelo ta van'wana leyi kumaka xibalo lexi.
councils.no_beneficiary: A ku na mali leyi hlanganisiweke, hikwalaho xibalo xi humesiwa kambe a ku na nchumu lowu kunguhatako ku xi hakela.
councils.no_rate: A ku na mpimo lowu tsariweke — a ku na nchumu lowu nga ta humesiwa.

councils.percent_line: {employee}% eka mutirhi ni {employer}% eka mutirhisi, swi pimiwile eka {ceiling}.
councils.nobody_covered: A ku na munhu loyi a funengetiwaka hi huvo leyi sweswi.
councils.rate_help: Xiboho lexi tirhaka xi pfaleriwa siku leri rhangeleke leri leri sungulaka, hikwalaho a ku na siku leri funengetiweke kambirhi.
councils.ceiling_hint: Tihuvo ti veka mpimo eka swibalo swa phesente. Handle ka wona loyi a holaka swinene u humeseriwa ku tlula mpimo n'hweti ni n'hweti.

report_sources.projects: Ku suka eka tiphurojeke hi tona — Tiphurojeke, kutani u pfula yin'we.
report_sources.work: Ku suka eka tluka ra Ntirho ra phurojeke yin'wana na yin'wana, laha xivumbeko ni mintirho ya xona swi akiwaka kona.
report_sources.dependencies: Ku suka eka Ntirho → Hlanganisa mintirho, laha ntirho wun'we wu endliwaka leswaku wu yimela wun'wana.
report_sources.schedule: Swi hlayiwa hi mukunguhati ku suka eka vuleha bya mintirho ni vuhlanganisi bya yona. Swi tirhise eka tluka ra Xikimu ra phurojeke.
report_sources.baseline: Swi ringanisa namuntlha na layini ya masungulo leyi hlayisiweke. Hlayisa yin'wana eka tluka ra Xikimu ra phurojeke.
report_sources.recurrence: Ku suka eka nawu wo phindza-phindza endzeni ka ntirho, eka tluka ra Ntirho.
report_sources.evidence: Ku suka eka rejista ya vumbhoni — nsimu ya xitirhisiwa, varhumeri va timodyulu ni API yo nghenisa.
report_sources.figures: Swi humelela eka vumbhoni. Languta tluka ra Tinhlayo ra phurojeke leswaku u kuma milawu leyi nga endzhaku ka nhlayo yin'wana na yin'wana.
report_sources.timesheets: Ku suka eka Vukorhokeri → Nkarhi eka phurojeke. Engetela vanhu ku sungula eka thebe ya Vanhu — tiawara ti tsariwa hi xirho.
report_sources.assignments: Ku suka eka Ntirho, hi ku nyika xirho ntirho, hi phesenti ya ku avanyisiwa. Engetela vanhu ku sungula eka Vukorhokeri → Vanhu.
report_sources.labour: Tiawara leti pfumeleriweke × ntsengo. Veka ntsengo loko u tsala tiawara eka Vukorhokeri → Nkarhi; ku hlayiwa tiawara leti pfumeleriweke ntsena.
report_sources.costs: Ku suka eka Vukorhokeri → Tihakelo eka phurojeke, laha switirhisiwa, mitshini ni vakhontiraka va le hansi swi tsariwaka kona. Ku hlayiwa leswi pfumeleriweke ni leswi hakeriweke ntsena.
report_sources.members: Ku suka eka Vukorhokeri → Vanhu eka phurojeke.
report_sources.approvals: Swi tumbuluxiwa hi ku tisungulela loko tiawara kumbe tihakelo swi rhumeriwa. Leswaku i mani la endlaka xiboho swi vekiwa eka Setup → Ndlela yo pfumelela.
report_sources.links: Ku suka eka tluka ra phurojeke, hi ku hlanganisa rhekhodo ya modyulu wun'wana — xifuwo, odara yo xava, khontiraka.

registers.review_hint: Khombo leri nga riki na munhu loyi a ri kambelaka i khombo leri nga riki na n'wini.
registers.closure_hint: Ri hundzile, ri lawuriwile, kumbe ri amukeriwile — vula leswaku i rihi.
registers.task_hint: A swi sindzisiwi. Swi hlanganisa xiphiqo ni ntirho lowu xi wu khumbaka.

registers.impact_note: Vula leswi swi swi endlaka eka vuanami, tihakelo, nkarhi ni nkoka. Siya bokisi ri nga ri na nchumu loko u nga tivi hi ntiyiso — 0 leyi u nga vuliki nchumu yi hunguta ku cinca ntsena loko un'wana a yi amukela.
registers.impact_days_hint: Nomboro leyi nga ehansi ka ziro yi tshinelisa siku.
registers.realise_note: Khombo ri sala eka nxaxamelo tanihi leri humeleleke, kasi xiphiqo lexintshwa xi kombetela endzhaku ka rona — ku hlangana koloko i vumbhoni bya leswaku a ku ri ni munhu loyi a a ri vona ri ta.
registers.confirm_submit_body: {code} yi ya eka hinkwavo lava amukelaka ku cinca eka projeke leyi. A wu nge swi koti ku yi cinca loko ya ha kamberiwa.
registers.confirm_implement_title: Tirhisa ku cinca loku eka pulani?
registers.confirm_implement_body: {code} ya tirhisiwa naswona ku tekiwa xisekelo, leswaku vuyelo bya yona eka nkarhi byi ta pimiwa endzhaku ka sweswo.
registers.close_needs_note: Vula leswaku khombo ri pfariwa hikuva yini.
registers.needs_root_cause: Xiendlakalo kumbe xiphiqo xa nkoka xi fanele xi tsala xivangelo xa xona xa masungulo.
registers.change_not_editable: Xikombelo xolexo xo cinca xi le ka loyi a amukelaka.
registers.change_not_approved: I ku cinca loku amukeriweke ntsena loku nga tirhisiwaka.
registers.no_flow_auto: A ku na ndlela yo amukela leyi vekiweke swikombelo swo cinca eka ndhawu leyi ya ntirho, hikwalaho xi tsariwile tanihi lexi amukeriweke.

portfolio.title: Photifoliyo
portfolio.subtitle: Minongonoko ni tiprojeke, ni leswi swi tirhisiwaka ha swona.
portfolio.portfolio_hint: Ntlawa wa minongonoko ni tiprojeke leti phikizanaka hi mali leyi fanaka.
portfolio.programme_hint: Ntlawa wa tiprojeke leti tisaka mbuyelo wun'we swin'we.
portfolio.empty_title: A ku na nchumu lowu hlanganisiweke ku fikela sweswi
portfolio.empty_body: Nongonoko i ntlawa wa tiprojeke leti tisaka mbuyelo wun'we — xibedlhele: vuaki, IT ni vatirhi. Photifoliyo i ntlawa wa minongonoko ni tiprojeke leti phikizanaka hi mali leyi fanaka. Hinkwaswo a swi sindzisiwi: loko u endla mintirho leyi nga fambelaniki, a wu lavi na wun'we.
portfolio.no_projects: A ku na tiprojeke eka nongonoko lowu ku fikela sweswi.
portfolio.direct: Hi ku kongoma eka photifoliyo leyi
portfolio.unassigned_sub: Ti kombisiwile leswaku nomboro leyi nga ehenhla yi nga ti rivali hi ku miyela.
portfolio.budget_hint: Leswi photifoliyo leyi yi nga swi tirhisaka. Handle ka swona a ku na nchumu wo ringanisa na wona.
portfolio.outcome_hint: Xivulwa xin'we. Nongonoko lowu nga riki na mbuyelo wun'we i photifoliyo hi vito rin'wana.
portfolio.assign_note: Projeke leyi nga eka nongonoko yi teka photifoliyo ya nongonoko wolowo hi yona — tinhlamulo timbirhi eka “i yihi photifoliyo” hi ndlela leyi tinomboro ti nga ringaniki ha yona.

templates.title: Tithemplate ta projeke
templates.subtitle: Laha projeke leyintshwa yi nga sungulaka kona, leswaku swiyenge leswi vanhu va swi rivalaka swi va kona.
templates.capture_sub: Cinca ntirho lowu fambeke kahle wu va masungulo ya lowu landzelaka.
templates.capture_note: Masiku ma hlayisiwa tanihi swivandla ku suka eku sunguleni ka projeke, ku nga ri tanihi masiku ya khalendara — themplate leyi nga ni masiku ya xiviri i ntiyiso hi siku leri yi tsariweke ha rona kutani yi hoxisa masiku hinkwawo lama landzelaka.
templates.none: A ku na tithemplate ku fikela sweswi.
templates.none_hint: Teka projeke leyi fambeke kahle, kutani leyi landzelaka yi sungula eka yona.
templates.sub_type_hint: Tiyindlu, magondzo, ERP, khampeyini — hambi vanhu va swi vitana njhani.
templates.confirm_remove_body: {name} a yi nga ha nyikiwi. Tiprojeke leti endliweke ha yona a ti khumbiwi.
templates.confirm_hide_body: {name} i themplate leyi rhumeriweke, hikwalaho ya tumbetiwa ematshan'weni ya ku yi sula — ku yi sula a ku ta vuya eka ku antswisiwa loku landzelaka.
templates.start_from_sub: Projeke leyi a yi si va ni pulani, hikwalaho yi nga vekiwa ehenhla ka yona.

gates.title: Tinyangwa ta swiyenge
gates.subtitle: Leswi swi faneleke swi va ntiyiso emahlweni ka loko projeke leyi yi ya emahlweni.
gates.field_criteria: Leswi swi faneleke swi va ntiyiso
gates.criteria_hint: Swi tsariwile emahlweni ka xiboho, ku nga ri endzhaku ka xona.
gates.waiver_needs_reason: Nyangwa leyi siyiweke yi fanele yi vula leswaku hikuva yini. Ku hundza yin'wana handle ka xivangelo i xiviko lexi suriwaka hi ku nonoka.
gates.none: A ku na tinyangwa eka projeke leyi.
gates.none_hint: Handle ka yin'we, xiyenge i leyibula leyi un'wana a yi cincaka.

site_records.title: Swirhendzevutani swa ndhawu ya ntirho
site_records.subtitle: Swiletelo, ku kamberiwa, ku xiyisisiwa ni ku hetiwa — maphepha lawa xikombelo xi vulavuriwaka ha wona.
site_records.instructions_sub: Leswi u byeriweke leswaku u swi endla, rini, na mani
site_records.tests_sub: Swikombiso leswi tekiweke, ni leswi laboratori yi swi vuleke
site_records.inspections_sub: “Tanani mi ta languta emahlweni ka loko ndzi funengeta”
site_records.completion_sub: Hi ku tirha, hi swiyenge ni hi ku hetelela — tisetifikheti leti ntshunxaka mali leyi hlayisiweke
site_records.raise_variation: Endla leswaku xi va ku cinca
site_records.unconverted_title: Swiletelo swa {count} leswi komberiweke tanihi ku cinca kasi swi nga endliwanga ku cinca
site_records.unconverted_body: Hi kona laha mali yi lahlekaka kona eka akhawunti yo hetelela. Swi endleni ku cinca, kumbe mi susa xikombelo.
site_records.overdue_inspections: Ku xiyisisiwa ka {count} loku komberiweke kasi ku nga si tsariwa
site_records.no_instructions: A ku na swiletelo leswi tsariweke.
site_records.no_instructions_hint: “Mi hi byele” i ku kanetana ntsena loko ku ri ni nkombiso ni siku.
site_records.no_tests: A ku na swikombiso leswi tsariweke.
site_records.no_inspections: A ku na ku xiyisisiwa loku komberiweke.
site_records.no_inspections_hint: Ku hundziwa hi kun'we hi swona leswi cincaka ntirho lowu hetiweke leswaku wu va ntirho lowu faneleke ku pfuriwa nakambe.
site_records.no_completion: A ku na nchumu lowu tiyisisiweke ku fikela sweswi.
site_records.no_completion_hint: Ku hetiwa hi ku tirha ku sungula nkarhi wa swihoxo naswona hakanyingi ku ntshunxa hafu ya mali leyi hlayisiweke.
site_records.issued_by_hint: Injhiniyara kumbe muyimeri wa mutirhisi — hakanyingi ku nga ri munhu la nga ni akhawunti laha.
site_records.field_instruction: Leswi u byeriweke leswaku u swi endla
site_records.field_variation: Hi xi teka tanihi ku cinca
site_records.variation_hint: Tsala mavonelo ya wena sweswi, ku nga ri hi tin'hweti leti taka loko akhawunti yi kanetiwa.
site_records.instruction_sub: Xi humesiwile emahlweni ka loko un'wana a pfumela leswaku i ku cinca — hi xikongomelo xa xona.
site_records.element_hint: “Xisekelo xa le hansi, xivandla 3” — swi ringanele ku xi kuma nakambe.
site_records.fail_raises_ncr: Ku kamberiwa loku tsandzekeke ku pfula ku nga landzeleli milawu hi kwona. Leswi swi chiweke ehenhla ka kona swi se swi funengetiwile, hikwalaho leswi a swi siyiwi eka xiboho xa un'wana.
site_records.requested_for_hint: Ku xiyisisiwa loku lavekaka namuntlha nimadyambu a hi xitiviso.
site_records.inspection_sub: Ku komberiwile emahlweni ka loko ntirho wu funengetiwa.
site_records.outstanding_hint: Nxaxamelo lowu fambaka ni setifikheti. Ku hetiwa hi ku tirha ku nyikiwa ku ha ri ni ntirho lowu saleke — sweswo i swa ntolovelo.
site_records.certify_sub: Leswi swi ntshunxa mali leyi hlayisiweke naswona swi sungula wachi ya swihoxo.
site_records.certify_note: Ku hetiwa hi ku tirha ku ariwa loko ku ri ni xihoxo xa nkoka kumbe ku nga landzeleli milawu loku pfulekeke eka nxaxamelo — ku tiyisisa ehenhla ka kona ku lahla nkarhi wo ku lulamisa.
site_records.completion_blocked: Ku ni xihoxo xa nkoka kumbe ku nga landzeleli milawu loku pfulekeke ka {count}. Ku hetiwa hi ku tirha a ku nge tiyisisiwi ehenhla ka kona.
site_records.already_a_variation: Xiletelo xexo xi se xi ni xikombelo xo cinca.
site_records.raised_from_si: Xi huma eka xiletelo xa ndhawu {number}.
site_records.failed_test_body: Mbuyelo {result} lowu lwaka ni leswi vuriweke swa {specified} {unit}.
site_records.failed_test_reason: Ku kamberiwa ka switirhisiwa {reference} ku tsandzekile.

meetings.title: Minhlangano
meetings.subtitle: Nxaxamelo, swirhendzevutani, leswaku i mani loyi a a ri kona, ni leswi swi faneleke swi endliwa ha swona.
meetings.none: A ku na minhlangano ku fikela sweswi.
meetings.project_hint: Swiendlo swi nga va mintirho eka projeke ntsena, hikwalaho nhlangano lowu nga na yona wu hlayisa swiendlo swa wona eka swirhendzevutani.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Minhlangano ya {count} leyi khomiweke handle ka leswaku swirhendzevutani swi hangalasiwa
meetings.minutes_outstanding_body: Hi kona laha swiboho swi nyamalalaka kona hi ku miyela.
meetings.actions_n: swiendlo swa {open} leswi pfulekeke eka swa {total}
meetings.agenda_hint: Wu rhumeriwa emahlweni ka nhlangano; wu va xivumbeko xa swirhendzevutani.
meetings.minutes_note: Leswi nga endzeni swi tsariwa ni swirhendzevutani hi xikongomelo: “ku pfumelelanile eka nhlangano wa ndhawu ya ntirho” i ku kanetana ntsena loko xitsariwa xi vula leswaku i mani loyi a a ri kona ku pfumelelana na swona.
meetings.attendance: I mani loyi a a ri kona
meetings.actions_note: Swiendlo swi va mintirho eka projeke — xiendlo lexi hanyaka eka swirhendzevutani ntsena i xiendlo lexi nga riki na munhu loyi a xi endlaka.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” ni swirhendzevutani swa wona swa susiwa. Swiendlo leswi se swi endliweke swi va mintirho.

agile.title: Ti-sprint ni nxaxamelo lowu rindzeleke
agile.subtitle: Timhaka i mintirho ya ntolovelo, hikwalaho bodo, pulani ni maphepha ya nkarhi hinkwaswo swa ha tirha.
agile.backlog_sub: Leswi swi nga hleriwangiki swi ya ehansi — nchumu lowu nga riki na munhu loyi a wu vekaka emahlweni a wu ha ri wa nkoka ku tlula.
agile.epics_sub: Ntirho lowu tlulaka ti-sprint. Nhluvuko i timhaka ta wona, ku nga ri xipimo lexi hambaneke lexi nga ha nga pfumelelaniki na tona.
agile.releases_sub: Leswi swi humeke, ni leswi a swi ri eka swona.
agile.no_active: A ku na sprint leyi yaka emahlweni.
agile.no_active_hint: Hlela yin'wana, nghenisa timhaka eka yona, kutani u yi sungula.
agile.no_backlog: A ku na nchumu eka nxaxamelo lowu rindzeleke.
agile.no_releases: A ku na ku humesiwa loku hleriweke.
agile.no_goal: A ku na xikongomelo lexi vekiweke — sprint leyi nga na xona i bokisi ra nkarhi ntsena.
agile.remaining_of: Tiphoyinti ta {remaining} leti saleke eka ta {committed}
agile.stories_done: Timhaka ta {done} leti hetiweke eka ta {total}
agile.burndown: Girafu ya ku hela ka sprint
agile.goal_hint: Xivulwa xin'we. Loko u nga swi koti ku xi tsala, sprint a yi na xikongomelo.
agile.revision_hint: Handle ka swona, “a ku ri ni yini eka muxaka lowu” i ku ehleketa eka tin'hweti ta tsevu leti taka.
agile.close_note: Timhaka leti nga hetiwangiki ti vuyela eka nxaxamelo lowu rindzeleke, ku nga ri emahlweni ka sprint leyi landzelaka — ku ti hundzisela hi tona hi ndlela leyi sprint leyi landzelaka yi sungulaka ha yona yi se yi tele emahlweni ka loko un'wana a yi hlela.
agile.already_started: Sprint yoleyo yi se yi sungurile.
agile.one_at_a_time: Sprint yin'wana yi se yi ya emahlweni eka projeke leyi. Timbirhi hi nkarhi wun'we ti endla leswaku rivilo ni girafu ya ku hela swi nga twisisiwi.
agile.not_active: I sprint leyi yaka emahlweni ntsena leyi nga pfariwaka.
agile.closed_note: {name} yi pfariwile: tiphoyinti ta {completed} ti hetiwile eka ta {committed}.

portal.title: Tiprojeke ta wena
portal.subtitle: Leswi swi humelelaka eka mintirho ya wena, ni leswi swi lavaka wena.
portal.empty_title: A ku na nchumu laha wa wena
portal.empty_body: Phothali leyi yi kombisa tiprojeke leti u fambelanaka na tona tanihi mutirhisi kumbe tanihi kontraka. Loko u tirha laha, tiprojeke ta wena ti le hansi ka Tiprojeke.
portal.awaiting_title: Swilo swa {count} swi rindzele xiboho xa wena
portal.progress_note: Leyi i nomboro leyi fanaka ni leyi ntlawa lowu tirhaka wu yi vonaka — a yi hlayiwi hi ndlela yo hambana eka wena.
portal.no_milestones: A ku na swiyenge leswi vekiweke.
portal.changes_sub: Ku cinca eka vuanami, tihakelo kumbe masiku
portal.no_work: A ku na nchumu lowu nyikiweke wena ku fikela sweswi.
portal.hours_this_month: Tiawara ta {n} leti tsariweke n'hwetini leyi
portal.time_sub: Swi hundza eka ku amukeriwa loku fanaka ni ka tluka ra nkarhi ra un'wana ni un'wana.
portal.claims_sub: Leswi tiyisisiweke, ni leswi swa ha kamberiwaka
portal.documents_sub: Hinkwawo eka ntirho lowu lawa u nga ma vonaka, ni laha u nga hi rhumelaka nchumu
portal.no_documents: A ku na matsalwa ku fikela sweswi.
portal.rate_sub: Xipimo xin'we hi n'hweti — xi ya hi ku kongoma eka ntlawa lowu tirhaka.
portal.rate_dialog_sub: Ku tshembeka ku pfuna ku tlula ku va ni musa. A ku na munhu la pimiwaka hi leswi a ri yexe.
portal.rate_comment: Xihi ni xihi lexi u lavaka ku xi vula
portal.not_rated: A wu si pima n'hweti leyi.
portal.my_invoices_sub: Lulamisa invoyisi ya ntirho wa wena kutani u yi rhumela eka mufambisi wa projeke.
portal.new_invoice_sub: Xikombo xa wena ni nkarhi lowu wu katsiwaka.
portal.no_invoices: A wu si hakerisa eka projeke leyi.
portal.invoice_reference_hint: Hi ndlela leyi yi humelelaka eka invoyisi ya wena.
portal.cinvoice_empty: Engetela kwalomu ka layini yin'we, kumbe namarhela invoyisi ya wena, u nga si yi rhumela.
portal.cinvoice_sent: Invoyisi leyi se yi rhumeriwile naswona yi nga ha cinciwi.
portal.my_contracts_sub: Leswi u tirhaka ehansi ka swona eka ntirho lowu.
portal.task_raised: Xikombelo xa wena xi rhumeriwile eka ntlawa wa phurojeke.
portal.raise_request_sub: Xi ya hi ku kongoma eka vanhu lava fambisaka phurojeke leyi.
portal.request_detail: Vuxokoxoko byin’wana ni byin’wana lebyi pfunaka (a swi bohi)
portal.your_requests_sub: Leswi u swi kombeleke, ni laha swi fikeke kona
portal.delivery_sub: Leswi fikeleriweke, leswi saleke ni leswi hlwereke, hi phurojeke.
portal.whats_next_sub: Eka tiphurojeke hinkwato, leswi nga kusuhi ku sungula.
portal.nothing_scheduled: A ku na nchumu lowu kunguhatiweke.

assistant.title: Mupfuni
assistant.subtitle: Leswi datha yi swi vulaka leswaku swi lava nyingiso wa wena, ni mpfuno hi ku tsala.
assistant.nothing_urgent: A ku na nchumu lowu hatliseke
assistant.all_clear: A ku na nchumu wo funghiwa.
assistant.all_clear_hint: Projeke yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi tirhaka ya vika, yi le ndzeni ka swikombiso swa yona, naswona a yi na swiboho leswi siveriweke.
assistant.draft_sub: Tinomboro ti tekiwa eka projeke; xikombiso xi tsala marito lama xi rhendzeleke ntsena.
assistant.draft_warning: Pulani. Xi hlaye emahlweni ka loko u xi rhumela — tinomboro i ta xiviri, swivulwa a swi si va swa wena.
assistant.no_provider: A ku na munyiki wa AI loyi a vekiweke eka ndhawu leyi ya ntirho, hikwalaho ku tsala a ku kumeki. Hinkwaswo leswi nga ehenhla swi hlayiwa ku suka eka datha ya wena naswona a swi lavi munhu.
assistant.slipping_detail: {name} yi kume {spi} ya nkoka lowu a yi hlerile ku wu kuma sweswi.
assistant.overspend_detail: {name} yi vuyisela {cpi} ya nkoka eka leswi yi swi tirhiseke.
assistant.overloaded_detail: Tiawara ta {hours} leti hleriweke eka n'hweti ya tiawara ta {capacity}, eka tiprojeke ta {projects}.
assistant.silent_title: Tiprojeke leti tirhaka ta {count} a ti viki nchumu eka mavhiki mambirhi
assistant.silent_detail: Projeke leyi nga vikiki nchumu a hi projeke leyi fambaka kahle — hi leyi nga riki na munhu loyi a nga vulaka nchumu ha yona.
assistant.risk_title: Makhombo lamakulu ya {count} lama nga riki na ku lulamisiwa loku tsariweke
assistant.risk_detail: Ma ni tiphoyinti ta 15 kumbe ku tlula, kasi a ku na nchumu lowu tsariweke hi leswi swi endliwaka.
assistant.change_title: Swikombelo swo cinca swa {count} leswi rindzeleke ku tlula vhiki
assistant.change_detail: Swi rhumeriwile kasi a ku si endliwa xiboho. Pulani ni xiboho swa hambana.
assistant.issue_title: Swiphiqo swa {count} leswi hundzeriweke hi siku ra swona
assistant.issue_detail: Swi pfulekile, swi nyikiwe vanhu, naswona swi hundzile nkarhi.

alerts.overdue_title: Mintirho ya {count} leyi se yi hundzeriweke hi siku ra yona
alerts.overdue_detail: Ya ha pfulekile, kasi masiku lama nga eka pulani a ma ha vuli nchumu.

alerts.mail_subject: {code}: swilo swa {count} leswi u faneleke u swi languta

chat.title: Bulo ra projeke
chat.subtitle: Ra bulo leri nga si vaka ntirho.
chat.empty: A ku na leswi vuriweke ku fikela sweswi.

equipment.title: Ku xiyisisiwa ka switirhisiwa
equipment.sub: Ku xiyisisiwa emahlweni ka ku tirhisiwa — nkoka i ntlhandlamano lowu nga tshoveki, ku nga ri kun'we ka kona
equipment.none: A ku na ku xiyisisiwa ka switirhisiwa loku tsariweke.
equipment.identifier_hint: Yi skene kumbe u yi tsala. Khodi leyi nga fambelaniki ni nchumu eka fayele ya ha fanele ku tsariwa.
equipment.field_signed_by: Tsala vito ra wena ku sayina
equipment.signed_hint: Vito ra wena, nkarhi ni adirese ya wena swa tsariwa — ku fana ni ku sayina xitsalwa.

contractors.title: Ti-invoyisi ta vakontiraka
contractors.subtitle: Leswi vakontiraka va swi rhumeleke hikwalaho ka ntirho eka tiphurojeke ta wena.
contractors.none: A ku na nchumu lowu rindzeleke xiboho.
contractors.markup_hint: A swi bohi, naswona a swi tshame swi kombisiwa mukhasimende kumbe mukontiraka. Siya swi nga ri na nchumu loko ku nga ri na wona.
contractors.reject_sub: Mukontiraka u kombisiwa xivangelo xa wena, hikwalaho tsala nchumu lowu a nga tekaka goza ha wona.
contractors.no_contractors: A ku na vakontiraka eka phurojeke leyi sweswi.
contractors.billable_to_date: Leswi nga hakeriwaka ku fikela sweswi
contractors.no_email: Mukontiraka loyi a nga ri na adirese ya imeyili, hikwalaho xikontiraka a xi nge rhumeriwi.
contractors.not_submitted: I invoyisi leyi rhumeriweke ntsena leyi nga pfumeleriwaka kumbe ya aleriwa.
contractors.register_sub: Hinkwavo lava u endlaka na vona swikontiraka, na hinkwaswo ha vona.
contractors.register_empty: A ku na vakontiraka sweswi. Engetela wo sungula.
contractors.none_matching: A ku na mukontiraka la fambelanaka na sweswo.
contractors.add_sub: Vito ra vona na ndlela yo va kuma. Va nyike phurojeke kutani va kuma mpfikelelo wa portal leswaku va ku hakerisa.
contractors.from_suppliers: Leti i tirhekhodo ta wena ta vaphakeri. Ku engetela un'wana laha swi n'wi nghenisa na le ka Supplier Management.
contractors.field_email_hint: Laha xirhambo xa vona xa portal xi yaka kona.
contractors.field_project_hint: A swi bohi. Va rhambiwa eka portal loko va ri karhi va tirha.
contractors.on_projects: tiphurojeke ta {count} | phurojeke ya {count} | tiphurojeke ta {count}
contractors.engage_sub: Va rhambiwa eka portal loko va nga si rhambiwa.
contractors.not_on_any_project: A va kona eka phurojeke yihi na yihi sweswi.
contractors.no_login: A ku na ku nghena ka portal sweswi
contractors.no_work: A ku na nchumu lowu va avelweke wona eka phurojeke leyi.
contractors.their_invoices_sub: Hinkwaswo leswi va swi rhumeleke, eka tiphurojeke hinkwato.
contractors.our_signatory: Loyi a sayinaka hi vito ra hina
contractors.our_signatory_hint: Va byeriwa eka app, naswona xikontiraka xi rindzele sayino ra vona laha.

contracts.title: Swikontiraka
contracts.subtitle: Swikontiraka swa phurojeke — swi tsariwa, swi cinciwa, swi kamberiwa naswona swi sayiniwa laha.
contracts.draft_sub: Sungula hi xin'wana xa switemplate swa wena, kumbe u nga sunguli nchumu.
contracts.template_hint: Switemplate swa wena swa phurojeke. Siya swi nga ri na nchumu leswaku u titsalela milawu.
contracts.title_hint: Siya swi nga ri na nchumu leswaku xi thyiwa hi mukontiraka na phurojeke.

data_sources.title: Swihlovo swa datha
data_sources.subtitle: Swihlovo leswi khampani leyi yi tiyisisaka vaphakeri ha swona, leswi xihlovo xin'wana ni xin'wana xi nga swi hlamulaka, ni minkambelo leyi ku nga riki na munhu la nga yi hlamulaka.
data_sources.ledger_broken: Nkatsakanyo wa vumbhoni a wu pfumelelani eka xinghenisiwa xa {at} ({reason}). Teka vumbhoni lebyi khumbekaka tanihi lebyi nga tiyisisiwangiki ku fikela loko ku lavisisiwile.
data_sources.coverage_help: Nkambelo wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu modyulu lowu wu wu tivaka ku wu endla, ni leswaku i mani la wu hlamulaka namuntlha. Nkambelo lowu nga riki na xihlovo a wu tluriwi — wu tsariwa tanihi lowu nga kumekiki ku fikela loko munhu a wu endla ivi a tsala leswi a swi kumeke.
data_sources.manual_notice: Minkambelo ya {count} a yi na xihlovo lexi lulamisiweke, hikwalaho munhu u fanele ku yi endla ivi a tsala leswi a swi kumeke.
data_sources.enable_label: Tirhisa xihlovo lexi eka ku tiyisisa
data_sources.enable_help: Loko leswi swi timiwile, minkambelo leyi a yi ta hlamuriwa yi tsariwa tanihi leyi nga kumekiki ematshan'weni ya ku hundza.
data_sources.credentials_help: Swi sirhelelekile laha swi hlayisiweke kona naswona a swi tlheriseriwi eka xikirini lexi. Nghenisa xilotlelo ku xi cinca; swilotlelo leswi u nga swi tsalaka nakambe swa hlayisiwa.
data_sources.enabled_checks: Minkambelo leyi xihlovo lexi xi nga yi hlamulaka
data_sources.default_for_help: Laha swihlovo swo tlula xin'we swi nga hlamulaka nkambelo, lexi xi vutisiwa ku sungula.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Swihlovo leswi hakeriwaka swi teka mali hi xirhambo xin'wana ni xin'wana. Loko xiavelo xi herile, minkambelo yi tsariwa tanihi leyi nga kumekiki ematshan'weni ya ku ku hakerisa.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Adirese leyi akhawunti ya wena leyi pfumeleriweke yi yi nyikaka eka nkambelo wun'wana ni wun'wana. Tindhawu to tata ti tatiwa ku suka eka muphakeri.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Tindhawu to tata: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: Xi tshama xi kumeka. Munhu u endla nkambelo eka xihlovo ivi a tsala leswi a swi kumeke — swi nghena eka buku leyi fanaka ya swivoniwa, hi xinghenisiwa xa vumbhoni lexi fanaka, swi tsariwe evitweni ra yena.
data_sources.none_match: A ku na xihlovo lexi fambisanaka na sweswo.
data_sources.profiled: Ku kamba ka {count} ku se ku tiva laha ku fonelaka kona. Nghenisa vuxokoxoko bya wena kutani swi ta tirha — masimu ya le hansi i ya konteraka leyi hambaneke ntsena.

mine.blocking: {count} wa tithikithi ta wena wu herile naswona wu ku sivela ku tirha. A wu nge nyikiwi mpfumelelo kumbe u sayiniwa eka ntirho ku fikela wu pfuxetiwa.

mine.induction_current: Dyondzo ya wena ya ndhawu ya ha tirha.
mine.induction_not_current: Dyondzo ya wena ya ndhawu a yi tirhi. U nga tlheriselwa enyangweni.

mine.all_acknowledged: U tiyisisile ndlela yin'wana ni yin'wana leyi nyikiweke eka wena.

mine.footnote: Leyi hi rhekhodo yin'we leyi hlayiwaka hi tirhijistara na nyangwa. Loko nchumu wun'wana laha wu hoxeke, wu hoxeke hinkwako — byela mufambisi wa wena wa nsirhelelo ku nga ri ku tirha u wu papalata.

matrix.title: Metriki ya Vutivi
matrix.subtitle: I mani loyi a faneleka eka yini, na laha hi pfumalaka
matrix.no_gaps: Vutivi byin'wana ni byin'wana lebyi lavekaka byi khomiwe hi hinkwavo lava byi lavekaka eka vona.
matrix.not_required: A byi laveki eka munhu loyi
matrix.capped: Yi kombisa vanhu va {shown} eka {total}. Girida yi anama hi ntumbuluko, hikwalaho yi pimiwile.
matrix.nothing_required: A ku na vutivi lebyi se byi laveke eka munhu. Leswi a swi fani na leswaku hinkwavo va landzela milawu — swi vula leswaku a ku na nchumu lowu nga kambelwa ha wona.
matrix.footnote: Swilaveko leswi fambisiweke na ntirho, ndzawulo kumbe ndhawu swi lulamisiwa laha mongo wolowo wu tiviwaka; girida leyi yi kombisa leswi fambisiweke na vanhu hi ku kongoma. Thikithi leri helaka ra ha hlayiwa tanihi leri khomiweke — ri tirha namuntlha.

safety_file.title: Fayili ya Nsirhelelo
safety_file.subtitle: Xiyenge xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi lavaka n'wini wa ndhawu leyi, na leswi nga endzeni ka xin'wana ni xin'wana.
safety_file.nothing_required: A ku na xiyenge lexi lavekaka sweswi, hikwalaho fayili a yi nge vi leyi heleleke kumbe leyi nga heleriki. Hlawula profayili ya bindzu ra wena kutani u yi lulamisa — hi leswi swi vulaka leswaku swiyenge swihi swi nga ni nkoka laha.
safety_file.incomplete: Swiyenge swa {count} leswi lavekaka a swi hetisisiwi
safety_file.complete: Xiyenge xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi lavekaka xi hetisisiwile. Fayili leyi a yi lavi khophi ya phepha.
safety_file.nothing_filed: A ku na nchumu lowu nghenisiweke eka xiyenge lexi.
safety_file.record_count: Tirhekhodo ta {count} ti hlayisiwile eka sisiteme leyi.
safety_file.history_count: {count} leti rhekhodiweke. Xiyenge lexi i matimu ku nga ri vumbhoni, hikwalaho a xi fanelanga ku tatiwa.
safety_file.drop_hint: Wisa tisetifikheti laha. Folidara ya zip yi pfuriwa yi va tsalwa rin'we hi fayili yin'wana ni yin'wana.

state.MISSING: A ku na nchumu lowu nghenisiweke
state.EXPIRED: Hinkwaswo leswi nga endzeni swi herile

safety_file.reason_hint: Swi tsariwile ehansi ka vito ra wena, naswona nkontiraka u byeriwa leswaku swi vula yini.
safety_file.valid_until_hint: Tshika swi nga tatiwi ku kuma tin'hweti ta {months} ku sukela namuntlha. Ri huma eka mpfumelelo hi siku leri hambi loko munhu a pfula xikirini kumbe a nga pfuli.
safety_file.reject_hint: Nkontiraka u fanele ku byeriwa leswaku a lulamisa yini. Ku ala handle ka xivangelo swi sungula riqingho ku nga ri tsalwa leri lulamisiweke.
safety_file.warning_days: Tsundzuxa masiku yo tala hi ndlela leyi ku rhanga
safety_file.warning_days_hint: Tshika swi nga tatiwi ku tirhisa xiyimo xa wena xa ntolovelo. Swi veke hi nkarhi lowu wu lavekaka hakunene ku cinca tsalwa leri.
safety_file.site_hint: Tshika swi nga tatiwi laha ri tirhaka eka tindhawu hinkwato. Tsalwa ra ndhawu yo karhi a ri fanelanga ku sivela nkontiraka eka tindhawu tin'wana.
safety_file.activities_hint: Tshika swi nga tatiwi laha ri tirhaka eka mintirho hinkwayo. Thikithi ra ku tlakusa ri ni nkoka eka ku tlakusa, ku nga ri eka ku penda.
safety_file.filed_as_hint: Ri nyikiwile swi vula leswaku ri fikile naswona munhu u fanele ku ri kambela. A ri hetisisi nchumu ku fikela ri amukeriwa.

state_hint.DRAFT: A ku na munhu loyi a kombelweke ku languta fayili leyi.
state_hint.SUBMITTED: Yi nyikiwile naswona yi rindzele munhu loyi a ta yi teka.
state_hint.UNDER_REVIEW: Munhu u na yona naswona u yi hundzuluxa.
state_hint.CHANGES_REQUIRED: Yi tlherisiwile. Leswi landzelaka leswi rhumelwaka i vhexini leyintshwa.
state_hint.APPROVED: Munhu loyi a ri ni vutivi u amukele fayili leyi. Yi yima ku tirha hi siku leri nga ehansi.
state_hint.SUSPENDED: A yi aliwi, kambe a yi tirhi. Vanhu va vona va aliwa enyangweni.
state_hint.EXPIRED: Mpfumelelo wu herile. Fayili leyintshwa yi fanele ku rhumelwa.
state_hint.BLOCKED: Yi aliwile. Fayili leyintshwa yi fanele ku rhumelwa.

move_hint.submit: Yi nyika fayili eka mani na mani loyi a kambelaka tifayili ta vakontiraka laha. A yi nge rhumelwi loko xiyenge lexi lavekaka xi nga hetisisiwi.
move_hint.request_changes: Yi yi tlherisa na nxaxamelo wa leswi faneleke ku cinca. Leswi landzelaka leswi rhumelwaka hi nkontiraka i vhexini leyintshwa, naswona leyi yi hlayisa xivangelo xa wena.
move_hint.approve: Yi amukela fayili hilaha yi yimeke namuntlha. Mpfumelelo i xivulwa mayelana na matsalwa lama nga endzeni hi siku leri, hikwalaho wu rhwele siku ro hela.
move_hint.suspend: Yi yimisa mpfumelelo ku tirha handle ka ku ala fayili. Vanhu va vona va aliwa enyangweni ku fikela yi vuyisiwa.

safety_file.may_work: Vanhu va vona va nga tirha endhawini.
safety_file.may_not_work: Vanhu va vona va aliwa enyangweni.
safety_file.not_blocking: A swi lulamile, kambe a swi ali ku nghena
safety_file.rules_hint: Xiboho xa wena, ku nga ri xa sisiteme. Xiyimo xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi nga ehansi xi kambelwa naswona xi vikiwa hambi ku ri kwihi; swiswitjhi leswi swi hlawula leswaku swihi swa swona swi ala hakunene nkontiraka enyangweni. Swi tirha eka nkontiraka wun'wana ni wun'wana, hikuva ku swi tirhisa handle ka ku ringana hi laha ntlhontlho enyangweni wu humelelaka.

status_hint.COMPLIANT: Hinkwaswo leswi lavekaka swi le fayilini, a swi herile naswona swi amukeriwile.
status_hint.EXPIRING: A ku na nchumu lowu pfumalekaka, kambe nchumu wun'wana wu hela nkarhi ku nga ri khale.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Nchumu wun'wana lowu lavekaka a wu lulamile. U hlawurile ku nga ali ku nghena hikwalaho ka wona.
status_hint.BLOCKED: Xiyimo lexi u sivelaka ha xona a xi hetisisiwi.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Fayili yi eka mukambeli. A ku na nchumu lowu pfumalekaka — a ku na munhu loyi a yi amukeleke.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Munhu u yimisile fayili leyi. Sweswo swi tlula hinkwaswo leswi hlayiweke.

activities.title: Migingiriko
activities.subtitle: Ntirho lowu endliwaka endhawini, ni leswi muxaka wun'wana ni wun'wana wu swi lavaka leswaku wu pfumeleriwa.
activities.name: Vito
activities.code_hint: Leswi muhlayi wa khadi, mpfumelelo kumbe API swi swi rhumelaka. Maletere lamakulu, ku nga vi na switlhelo.
activities.requires_hint: Vumbhoni lebyi munhu a faneleke ku va na byona. Mutirhi la nga riki na byin'wana bya byona u aleriwa ntirho lowu hi vito.
activities.requires_nothing: A ku na vutshila byo karhi
activities.who_can: I mani a nga wu endlaka
activities.high_risk_hint: Swi wu funghela leswaku wu languteriwa nakambe. Nyangwa yi tirha hi leswi ntirho wu swi lavaka, ku nga ri hi leswi.
activities.permit_hint: Mpfumelelo wu fanele ku pfuriwa ntirho lowu wu nga si sungula.
activities.retire_body: A wu ha nyikiwi. Mipfumelelo ni swiendlakalo swo nghena leswi se swi tsariweke eka wona swi tshama swi hlayeka, naswona khodi yi nga tlhela yi tirhisiwa endzhaku.
activities.no_match: A ku na ntirho lowu fambisanaka ni sweswo.
activities.empty_title: A ku na nchumu eka nxaxamelo sweswi
activities.empty_body: Ku fikela loko ntirho wu vula leswi wu swi lavaka, nyangwa leyi vutisiwaka leswaku “xana munhu loyi a nga tirha ehenhla” a yi na nchumu leyi nga swi kambela naswona yi pfumelela hinkwavo. Sungula hi nxaxamelo wa Afrika Dzonga lowu taka kutani u cinca leswi un'wana ni un'wana a swi lavaka.
activities.unstaffed: Migingiriko ya {n} leyi ku nga riki na munhu endhawini la faneleke eka yona sweswi. Kumbe switifikheti swi fanele ku landzeleriwa, kumbe xilaveko a xi lulamanga.
activities.advisory_title: Vutshila lebyi pfumalekaka bya tsariwa, a byi aleriwi
activities.advisory_body: Munhu la pfumalaka vumbhoni lebyi lavekaka wa hundzisiwa naswona xivandla xi tsariwa. Pfula “Vutshila lebyi pfumalekaka bya ntirho” eka milawu yo sivela vakontiraka leswaku ku aleriwa ematshan'weni ya sweswo.

attendance.title: Endhawini
attendance.subtitle: I mani la nga kona sweswi, i mani la ngheneke a huma, ni la nga sainangiki loko a huma.
attendance.long_stays_hint: Vanhu va {n} va tshame endhawini nkarhi lowu tlulaka tiawara ta {hours}. Xifti xa vusiku na xona xi vonaka hi ndlela leyi — kambe na ndhawu laha ku nga riki na loyi a sainaka loko a huma.
attendance.nobody_on_site: A ku na loyi a sainaka a nghena.
attendance.no_movements: A ku na ku famba loku tsariweke.
attendance.no_site: A ku na ndhawu leyi tsariweke
attendance.no_employer: A ku na mutholi la tsariweke
attendance.search: Lavisisa hi vito, mutholi kumbe ntirho
attendance.when_hint: Siya swi nga ri na nchumu leswaku ku va sweswi. Nkarhi lowu hundzeke wa amukeriwa, ku tsala nxaxamelo wa phepha; lowu taka a wu amukeriwi.
attendance.manual_note: Swi tsariwa tanihi leswi nghenisiweke hi voko, leswaku vuhlahluvi byi swi hambanisa ni ku skena. Muhlayi lowu nga tirhiki a hi xivangelo xo siya munhu eka nxaxamelo.
attendance.everyone_in: Hinkwavo eka nxaxamelo se va ngheneke.
attendance.nobody_to_sign_out: A ku na loyi a sainaka a nghena.
attendance.monitor_only: A a ta aleriwa — nyangwa leyi yi le ka maendlelo yo languta.

overrides.title: Ku nghena ka xinkarhana
overrides.subtitle: I mani la pfumeleriweke ku hundza nyangwa leyi a nga fanelangi ku yi hundza, ni hi vulawuri bya mani.
overrides.explainer: Mpfumelelo wo hlawuleka wu amukela munhu loyi fayili yakwe yi nga riki eka xiyimo. Wu endliwe leswaku swi olova ku wu nyika — mukontiraka la nga ni ntirho a nga ri na ndlela yo nghena hi ndlela leyi vanhu va sainaka ha yona hi vito ra munghana — naswona wu sirhelelekile hikuva wun'wana ni wun'wana wu tsariwe laha ni xivangelo xa wona, la wu amukeleke ni makumu ya wona. A ku na lowu nga tirhaka nkarhi lowu tlulaka masiku ya {days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Leswi swi nghenisa endhawini munhu loyi a a ta aleriwa. Swi tsariwa hi vito ra wena, ni hi vito ra la amukeleke loyi u n'wi boxaka.
overrides.ending_soon: Wu hela ehansi ka tiawara ta 48
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Mipfumelelo ya {n} yi hela hi masiku mambirhi. Yi pfuxeni kumbe mi yi tshika yi hela — kambe endlani xiboho, ku nga ri ku yi kuma enyangweni.
overrides.search: Lavisisa hi munhu, xivangelo kumbe la amukeleke
overrides.show_closed: Kombisa leyi heleke ni leyi kokiweke
overrides.none_open: A ku na nchumu lowu hundzisiweke sweswi.
overrides.none_ever: A ku na mpfumelelo wo hlawuleka lowu tshameke wu nyikiwa.
overrides.reason_hint: Leswi munhu la nga ta languta leswi hi tin'hweti ta tsevu a nga ta swi tirhisa. Swimanyana swa khume.
overrides.conditions_hint: Leswi va faneleke ku swi endla loko wu ha tirha. Swi printiwa eka xiboho xa nyangwa loko khadi ra vona ri skeniwa.
overrides.starts_hint: Siya swi nga ri na nchumu leswaku wu sungula sweswi. Mpfumelelo wo pfala ntirho wu nga lunghiseleriwa siku ri nga si fika.
overrides.ends_hint: Swa laveka, naswona ntsena masiku ya {days} lama taka. Wu tipfala hi wexe.
overrides.site_hint: Siya swi nga ri na nchumu eka tindhawu hinkwato. Ku wu hunguta i ku hlawula loku sirhelelekeke.
overrides.activity_hint: Siya swi nga ri na nchumu eka ntirho hinkwawo.
overrides.approver_hint: Munhu loyi a wu pfumeleleke, loko ku nga ri wena. Siya swi nga ri na nchumu naswona wu tsariwa hi vito ra wena.
overrides.revoke_body: Nyangwa yi tlhelela laha a yi ri kona, hi ku hatlisa. Mani na mani la titshegeke hi leswi ku nghena endhawini mundzuku u ta aleriwa.
overrides.revoke_reason: Hikwalaho ka yini u wu koka

portal.title: Ku landzelela ka wena nsirhelelo
portal.subtitle: Leswi {host} a swi lavaka eka wena vanhu va wena va nga si tirha etindhawini takwe.
portal.not_a_contractor: A ku na nchumu lowu lavekaka eka wena laha
portal.not_a_contractor_body: A wu kona eka nxaxamelo wa vakontiraka wa muxavi loyi, kutani a ku na swilaveko swa nsirhelelo eka akhawunti ya wena. Loko vanhu va wena va tirha etindhawini takwe, va kombele leswaku va ku nghenisa.
portal.score_explained: Ntlhandlamo wun'we eka tsalwa rin'wana ni rin'wana, fayili ya wena ya nsirhelelo, ni ku tivisiwa ka munhu un'wana ni un'wana.

portal.with_them: Eka vona leswaku va swi kambela

portal.never_supplied: A ri si tshama ri nyikiwa

portal.rejected: Ri aleriwile — hi kombela u rhumela rin'wana

portal.no_workers: A ku na ni un'we wa vanhu va wena loyi a nga eka nxaxamelo wa muxavi loyi sweswi.

portal.on_file: Leswi va nga na swona eka fayili
portal.review_note: Xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi u xi rhumelaka xi kambeleriwa xi nga si hlayiwa. Xi ta vonaka xi rindzele ku kambeleriwa ku fikela loko va xi amukela; u nga titshegi ha xona enyangweni ku nga si va tano.

portal.upload_done: Ri rhumeriwile. Va ta ri kambela naswona ri ta hlayiwa loko ri amukeriwile.

notices.title: Swivhoniso swa vakontiraka
notices.subtitle: Leswi sisiteme leyi yi swi byelaka vakontiraka va wena, laha swi yaka kona, ni leswi hakunene swi humeke.

notices.channels_hint: Imeyili leyi tsarisiweke ya khamphani leyitsongo hakanyingi i ya mukambeli wa tibuku, leyi languteriwaka kan'we hi vhiki. Nomboro eka rhekhodo leyi fanaka hakanyingi i ya mulawuri wa ndhawu.

notices.what_we_send_hint: Xivhoniso xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi sisiteme leyi yi xi rhumelaka mukontiraka, ni leswi xi vangaka.

notices.unreachable_body: A va na adirese eka tindlela leti u ti hlawuleke, kutani a ku na na xin'we xa swivhoniso leswi lexi va fikelelaka. A ku na xihoxo lexi kombisiwaka — va nga byeriwi ntsena, ku fikela loko munhu a aleriwa enyangweni.

settings.approver_derived_hint: Mu-amukeri u kumiwa hi xikombelo xin'wana ni xin'wana.

settings.jurisdiction_title: Vulawuri na ku cinca ka mali

settings.fx_rate_type_hint: Wu fambisana na muxaka lowu hlayisiweke eka Finance, hakanyingi i spot.
settings.no_frameworks: A ku na swivumbeko swa ku hlawuleka leswi lulamisiweke.
settings.framework_no_bands: A ku na tibendi leti vekiweke. A ku na nchumu lexi nga ta averiwa ehansi ka xivumbeko lexi ku kondza ti vekiwa.
settings.retire_framework_body: Xivumbeko a xi ha nyikiwi eka tithendara letintshwa. Tithendara leti se ti nyikiweke tinhlayo ha xona ti hlayisa rhekhodo ya tona.
settings.basis_hint: Tinhlayo ti nyika hakelo; ndzilakano wu nyika vuhundzuluxi bya nxavo ematshan'weni ya sweswo.
settings.split_hint: Nxavo na ku hlawuleka swi fanele ku va 100.
settings.framework_notes_hint: Leswi swi sekeriwe eka yini, na leswi swa ha lavaka ku tiyisisiwa.
settings.bands_hint: Ti kamberiwa hi ku landzelelana; bendi ro sungula leri mukomberi a fambelanaka na rona hi rona leri tirhaka.
settings.band_value_hint: xik. 1, kumbe <=2 eka xiyimo 2 kumbe ku antswa
settings.field_local_content: Yi landzelela leswi nga endzeni ka tiko

settings.confirm_verified_note: Xivumbeko lexi xi ta funghiwa tanihi lexi tiyisisiweke, hi vito ra wena, loko u hlayisa.

portal.no_closing_date: A ku na siku ro pfala leri vekiweke
portal.local_content: Xikombelo lexi xi fikelela xilaveko xa leswi nga endzeni ka tiko
portal.confirm: Ndzi tiyisisa leswaku xikombelo lexi xi lulamile naswona xi rhumeriwa hi vito ra khampani leyi boxiweke laha henhla
portal.confirm_hint: Loko se xi rhumeriwile, xikombelo xa wena xi pfariwile naswona a xi nge cinciwi. Tihlanganisa na mutirhi wa ku xava loko u lava ku xi cinca.
portal.closed_warning: Thendara leyi se yi pfariwile. U nga ha rhumela, kambe xikombelo xa wena xi ta tsariwa tanihi lexi hlweleke naswona i komiti leyi nga ta boha loko xi nga anakanyiwa.
portal.received: Xikombelo xa wena xi pfariwile naswona xi amukeriwile
portal.received_body: Xi tshama xi pfariwile ku kondza thendara yi pfala, kutani xi pfuriwa swin'we na swikombelo swin'wana hinkwaswo hi vatirhi vambirhi.
portal.received_late: Xikombelo xa wena xi amukeriwile endzhaku ka nkarhi wo pfala
portal.received_late_body: Xi tsariwile tanihi lexi hlweleke. Loko xikombelo lexi hlweleke xi nga anakanyiwa i xiboho xa komiti hi ku ya hi milawu ya yona.
portal.receipt_hint: Xi hlayise. Xi kombisa xikombelo xa wena handle ko xi paluxa.
portal.footer: Xi rhumeriwile hi Mkhaya Hub. Nkhomu lowu i wa wena ntsena — u nga wu avelani.

intake.explainer: Vakomberi lava rhambiweke va rhumela hi nkhomu wa vona. Swikombelo swi tshama swi pfariwile ku kondza thendara yi pfala, kutani hinkwaswo swi pfuriwa swin'we hi vatirhi vambirhi.
intake.invite_hint: Swi endla nkhomu wa xihundla wa mukomberi loyi. N'wi rhumele wona — hi wona ntsena ndlela yakwe yo nghena.
intake.none_invited: A ku na vakomberi lava rhambiweke sweswi.
intake.link_once: Wu kombisiwile kan'we. Wu kope sweswi — a wu nge kombisiwi nakambe.
intake.withdraw_body: Xikombelo lexi pfariweke xa susiwa leswaku mukomberi loyi a kota ku rhumela nakambe. Havumbirhi ku susiwa na xikombelo lexintshwa swi tshama eka ndlela ya nkambelo.
intake.opening_explainer: Swikombelo hinkwaswo leswi pfariweke swi pfuriwa hi nkarhi wun'we, hi wena na mbhoni. Ku pfula ku humelela kan'we naswona a ku nge tlheriseriwi endzhaku.
intake.open_warning: Xikombelo xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi pfariweke xi va lexi hlayekaka hi nkarhi lowu, naswona a swi nge tlheriseriwi endzhaku. Ya emahlweni ntsena loko mbhoni ya wena yi ri kona.
intake.witness_hint: Munhu wa vumbirhi, la nga kona loko ku pfuriwa, la tsariweke eka thendara.

budgets_approval_setup.no_hr_notice: A ku na modyulu wa HR lowu nghenisiweke, hikwalaho goza leri vekiweke eka “mulawuri wa murhumeri” a ri nge hetisiwi hi munhu. Tirhisa xiyimo kumbe munhu la vuriweke ematshan'weni ya sweswo.

report_sources.budgets: Swi tsariwa loko mpimanyeto wu tumbuluxiwa, eka Timpimanyeto › Mpimanyeto Lowuntshwa.
report_sources.ledger: Swi huma eka buku ya ku vekeriwa, ku bohiwa na ku tirhisiwa ka mali.
report_sources.allocations: Tinhlaka to avanyisa leti tsariweke eka xiavelo xa mpimanyeto.
report_sources.reservations: Swi tsariwa loko xikombelo xo xava xi pfumeleriwa, kumbe swi nghenisiwa hi voko eka mpimanyeto.
report_sources.commitments: Swi tsariwa loko oda ro xava ri humesiwa, kumbe swi nghenisiwa hi voko eka mpimanyeto.
report_sources.consumptions: Swi tsariwa loko invoyisi kumbe GRN yi tsarisiwa, kumbe swi nghenisiwa hi voko eka mpimanyeto.
report_sources.adjustments: Swi pfuxiwa eka mpimanyeto tanihi ku engeteriwa, ku hunguteriwa kumbe ku hundziseriwa.
report_sources.overrides: Swi pfuxiwa eka mpimanyeto loko munhu a kombela ku tirhisa mali ku tlula xiavelo.
report_sources.approvals: Xiboho xin'wana na xin'wana lexi rhumeriweke, ku suka elayinini ya mimpfumelelo.
report_sources.decisions: Sayina rin'wana na rin'wana leri tsariweke eka xiboho lexi rhumeriweke.
report_sources.alerts: Swi pfuxiwa hi ku kambela ka vusiku hi ku ya hi milawu ya switsundzuxo ya khampani leyi.
report_sources.phasing: Swi tsariwile eka thebulu ya Phasing ya mpimanyeto wun'wana na wun'wana: tinguva leti pfariweke leti tluleke ndzilakano wa ku hambana wa lembe, na xivangelo lexi yin'wana na yin'wana yi hundzeke kungu ra yona.

budgets_planning.title: Ku lulamisela mpimanyeto
budgets_planning.subtitle: Hundzisela lembe, nghenisa rin'wana ku suka eka spredishiti, u pfala leri hetiweke.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Ku averiwa hi minkarhi ku lava minkarhi; lembe leri nga riki na yona a ri na pulani yo ringanisa na ku tirhisiwa ka mali.
budgets_planning.no_periods_hint: A ku na minkarhi leyi hlamuseriweke. Yi tumbuluxe eka Swipimelo leswaku timpimanyeto ti averiwa hi minkarhi.
budgets_planning.confirm_close_body: Timpimanyeto ta {name} ti pfariwa na rona. Ku bohiwa loku se ku endliweke ka ha lava ku hakeriwa hi invoyisi.
budgets_planning.carry_sub: Kopa timpimanyeto ta lembe u ti yisa eka leri landzelaka.
budgets_planning.mode_allocation_hint: Lembe leri landzelaka ri sungula hi nhlayo leyi lembe leri ri nga na yona — ndhawu leyi tolovelekeke yo sungula xijikelo lexintshwa.
budgets_planning.mode_unspent_hint: Lembe leri landzelaka ri sungula hi leswi a swi ha kumeka. Timpimanyeto leti nga riki na nchumu ta tlulisiwa.
budgets_planning.carry_notice: Hinkwaswo swi fika tanihi swikombiso. A ku na nchumu lowu tirhaka ku fikela loko munhu a swi pfumelela.
budgets_planning.import_sub: CSV, yi huma hi ku kongoma eka spredishiti leyi xijikelo xi sunguleke eka yona.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Tinhlaka ti kamberiwa yin'we hi yin'we. Nhlaka yo biha yi viwa hi nomboro ya layini; leti ti lulameke ta ha nghenisiwa, tanihi swikombiso.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Fayele leyi munghenisi a yi hlayaka hi xiviri, na tinhlaka timbirhi ta xikombiso leti taleke.
budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Mpimanyeto wun'wana na wun'wana eka fayele wu tumbuluxiwa eka lembe leri.
budgets_planning.hint_file: CSV ntsena, ku fikela eka 5 MB. Hlayisa tanihi “CSV UTF-8” eka Excel.
budgets_planning.how_title: Ndlela ku layicha ku tirhaka ha yona
budgets_planning.how_1: Layini yo sungula yi fanele ku va ya nhloko. Mavito ma ringanisiwa handle ko languta maletere lamakulu naswona swivandla swi va ti-underscore, hikwalaho “Allocated Amount” na “allocated_amount” i khumu yin'we.
budgets_planning.how_2: Ku landzelelana ka tikhumu a ku na mhaka, naswona tikhumu leti u nga ti lavi ti nga siyiwa hi ku helela eka fayele.
budgets_planning.how_3: Nhlaka yin'wana na yin'wana yi kamberiwa yi ri yoxe. Nhlaka leyi tsandzekaka yi viwa hi nomboro ya yona eka fayele kutani yi tlulisiwa — leti salaka ta ha nghenisiwa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Hinkwaswo swi fika tanihi swikombiso. A ku na nchumu lowu tirhaka, naswona a ku na nchumu lowu nghenaka elayinini ya mimpfumelelo ku fikela loko munhu a swi rhumela.
budgets_planning.how_5: Nkoka lowu munghenisi a nga wu tiviki — xiyenge lexi tsariweke hi ndlela leyi hoxeke kumbe muxaka wa ku tirhisiwa ka mali — a wu endli leswaku nhlaka yi tsandzeka. Wu tlhelela eka leswi tolovelekeke kutani wu tsariwa tanihi xitsundzuxo endzhaku.
budgets_planning.how_6: A ku na nchumu lowu susiwaka kambirhi. Ku layicha fayele yin'we kambirhi swi tumbuluxa timpimanyeto kambirhi, hikwalaho nghenisa fayele leyi lulamisiweke eka lembe lerintshwa kumbe u sungula hi ku susa swikombiso.
budgets_planning.columns_title: Leswi khumu yin'wana na yin'wana yi swi amukelaka
budgets_planning.col_help_name: Vito ra mpimanyeto, xik. “Vukorhokeri bya Hofisi Nkulu”. Vito leri nga riki na nchumu ri endla leswaku nhlaka yi tsandzeka.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Nomboro. Swifaniso swa mali, swivandla na swihambanisi swa magidi swa susiwa, hikwalaho “R 1 850 000,00” na “1850000” hakumbirhi swa tirha. Xin'wana na xin'wana lexi nga riki nomboro xi endla leswaku nhlaka yi tsandzeka.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: Yi tlhelela eka opex loko yi ri yoxe kumbe yi nga tiviwi.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: Yi fanele ku fambisana na rin'wana ra mavito ya swiyenge lama nga ehansi. Vito leri nga fambisaniki ri siya mpimanyeto wu nga ri na xiyenge naswona ri pfuxa xitsundzuxo.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: Yi tlhelela eka ya ntolovelo loko yi ri yoxe kumbe yi nga tiviwi.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Matsalwa yo ntshunxeka lama vitanaka ndzawulo, phurojeke kumbe senthara ya tihakelo, xik. “Hofisi Nkulu”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Khodi ya maletere manharhu ku fana na ZAR. Xin'wana na xin'wana xi honisiwa kutani ku tirha leyi tolovelekeke ya khampani.
budgets_planning.col_help_description: Matsalwa yo ntshunxeka. Ma kombisiwa eka tluka ra mpimanyeto.
budgets_planning.categories_title: Mavito ya swiyenge lawa fayele leyi yi nga ma tirhisaka
budgets_planning.categories_hint: Ku peleta ku ringanisiwa handle ko languta maletere lamakulu, kambe vito ri fanele ku va rona hi xiviri.
budgets_planning.categories_none: A ku na swiyenge sweswi. Swi engetele ehansi ka Lulamisa › Swipimelo, kumbe u siya khumu ya xiyenge yi ri yoxe.

document_management.change_note_hint: Ntila hi leswi hambaneke eka vhexini leyi.

settings_page.title: Swivekiwa swa matsalwa
settings_page.subtitle: Leswi swi nga nghenisiwa laha, vukulu byi ngani, na ndlela leyi matsalwa ma thyiwaka mavito.
settings_page.max_size_hint: Swi tirha eka fayili yin'wana ni yin'wana, ku nga ri eka ku nghenisa hinkwaswo.
settings_page.max_count_hint: Ti ngani leti nga wisiwaka hi nkarhi wun'we.
settings_page.types_help: Nxaxamelo wa mpfumelelo. Nchumu wun'wana ni wun'wana lowu nga riki eka wona wu aliwa.
settings_page.allowed_hint: Tshika swi nga riki na nchumu ku tirhisa sete ya ntolovelo.
settings_page.blocked_hint: Swi susiwa eka nxaxamelo lowu pfumeleriweke hambi swi ri kona eka wona.
settings_page.show_never: Leswi swi nga ta ka swi nga pfumeleriwi
settings_page.never_help: Leswi swi aliwa ku nga khathariseki leswi vekiweke. Muvoni kumbe seva swi nga swi tirhisa, naswona layiburari ya matsalwa a yi na xivangelo xo amukela xin'we.
settings_page.auto_name: Thya matsalwa mavito hi ku tihlanganisa
settings_page.require_description: Lava nhlamuselo eka ku nghenisa hinkwako
settings_page.categories_hint: Leswi tsalwa ri nga swona, ku hambana na laha ri nghenisiweke. Swiyenge leswi akiweke swi nga thyiwa mavito manwana kumbe swi pfaleriwa kambe a swi susiwi — swiviko na milawu ya ku hlayisa swi kombetela eka swona.
settings_page.category_order_hint: Leyi nga ehansi yi humelela ku rhanga
settings_page.category_protected: Swiyenge leswi akiweke a swi nge suseki. Ematshan'wini ya sweswo xi pfale.
settings_page.category_in_use: Xi tirhisiwa hi matsalwa ya {n}. Ematshan'wini ya sweswo xi pfale.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Tsundzuxa vanhu tsalwa ri nga si hela. Ku hlantswa ku tirha mixo wun'wana ni wun'wana naswona ku rhumela xitsundzuxo xin'wana ni xin'wana kan'we.
settings_page.expiry_days: Tsundzuxa masiku yo tala hi ndlela leyi ku rhanga
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Tshova enter endzhaku ka nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana. 0 swi vula hi siku ro hela hi roxe.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: N'wini wa tsalwa u tivisiwa nkarhi hinkwawo. Mintirho, ku nga ri mavito, leswaku xitsundzuxo xi landzela mani na mani loyi a khomeke ntirho.
settings_page.retention_hint: How long documents in this category are kept. Leave the period empty for no schedule — nothing is ever destroyed automatically.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Shown beside the disposal queue, so a reviewer can see what the rule is for.
settings_page.sharing_warning: With this on, anybody holding a share link can open that document without signing in. Each link still expires, can be revoked, and is recorded.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Allow documents to be shared outside the organisation
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: The ceiling for any link. Somebody asking for longer gets this.
settings_page.ai_warning: With this on, the contents of a document are sent to the AI provider this platform is configured with, and count against the company’s monthly allowance.
settings_page.ai_enabled: Allow summaries and questions about documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential: Include confidential and legally held documents
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Off by default. These are the documents an organisation is least willing to hand to an outside service.
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Each share can still be changed individually. A watermark makes a leaked copy traceable; it does not prevent one.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: With this on, documents a reviewer has approved for disposal are deleted without further confirmation. Deletion here is recoverable — permanent destruction always stays with a person.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: How long an approval waits before it is acted on, so a mistake can be caught.
settings_page.automation_hint: What this category does on its own once the dates above have passed.
settings_page.archive_after_years_hint: Counted from the same date as the retention period
settings_page.auto_delete: Delete automatically once a disposal is approved
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Needs the company-wide setting as well. Documents under legal hold are never touched.
settings_page.categories_delete_consequence: Only possible while nothing is filed under it.
settings_page.category_fields_hint: Leswi muxaka lowu wa tsalwa wu swi rhwalaka ehandle ka leswi tolovelekeke. Ntwanano wu lava mutlhavi; risiti a yi lavi nchumu.
settings_page.category_workflow_default: Endlelo ra muxaka lowu wa tsalwa
settings_page.category_workflow_hint: Leswaku "tipholisi ti ya eka nawu" ku va nchumu wa tipholisi ku ri na ku tsundzukiwa eka ku tirhisa kun'wana ni kun'wana.
settings_page.category_workflow_required: A yi nge hlengeletiwi handle ka yona
settings_page.numbering_next_hint: Yi veke ku ya emahlweni ku suka eka spreadsheet ku ri na ku sungula nakambe eka 1.
settings_page.numbering_pattern_hint: Tindhawu: {YYYY} {YY} {MM} na #### eka landzelelano. Yi siye yi nga ri na nchumu ku tirhisa tinomboro ta khampani.
settings_page.watermark_confidential: Minkarhi hinkwayo fungha matsalwa ya xihundla
settings_page.watermark_previews: Fungha swikombiso hi vito ra muhlayi
settings_page.watermark_previews_hint: Ku hlaya ntsena ku sivela ku dawunilodha kambe a ku endli nchumu hi xifaniso xa xikirini. Xifungho lexi vulaka leswaku i mani a a languta hi xona ntsena lexi endlaka sweswo.
settings_page.downloads_days_hint: Nkarhi lowu munhu a hlayisaka kopi leyi a yi amukeriweke.
settings_page.lock_hours_hint: Endzhaku ka leswi tsalwa ri tipfula, leswaku ku nga vi na loyi a siveriweke hi loyi a nga eku wiseni.

employee_reputation_dashboard.title: Ku Languteriwa ka Vito ni Khombo ya Mutirhi
employee_reputation_dashboard.subtitle: Ku languteriwa loku pfumeleriweke ka vutivi bya VANHU HINKWAVO eka mahungu, khoto, mulawuri, tinxupulo, vaaki ni swihlovo swa vutshila — ku kamberiwa hi munhu.
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_title: Nkambelo wa munhu — a ku na swiboho leswi tiendlaka
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_body: Modyuli lowu wu humesa vutivi bya VANHU HINKWAVO lebyi nga vaka bya nkoka swin'we ni mongo, ku tiyiseka ni laha byi humaka kona leswaku munhu a byi kambela. A wu endli kumbe ku bumabumela mimbuyelo ya ku thola, ku hlongola kumbe ya ndzayo. Ku fana ka vito a hi vumbhoni bya vunhu. Tirhisa ntsena hi mpfumelelo ni hi ku pfumelelana ni nawu wa xihundla ni wa vatirhi.
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain: Leswi kumekeke hi ndhawu ya xikombiso
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain_hint: Swikombiso swa vanhu hinkwavo swi hlanganisiwile hi ndhawu. Tindhawu leti kongomisaka eka khombo i ta nkambelo ntsena, ku nga ri swiboho.
employee_reputation_dashboard.domain_risk: Ku kongomisa eka khombo — ku kamberiwa
employee_reputation_dashboard.domain_positive: Mongo lowunene / lowu nga tekiki tlhelo
employee_reputation_dashboard.no_alerts: A ku na switsundzuxo leswi pfuriweke.
employee_reputation_dashboard.no_scans: A ku na swiskeno leswi endliweke.

employee_reputation_settings.title: Vulongoloxi bya ku languteriwa ka vito ni khombo
employee_reputation_settings.subtitle: Longoloxa ku languteriwa loku pfumeleriweke loku tirhisaka vutivi bya vanhu hinkwavo ntsena. Hinkwaswo leswi kumekaka swi humesiwa ku kamberiwa hi munhu.
employee_reputation_settings.enabled: Pfumelela ku languteriwa ka vito ni khombo
employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Pfumelela ku languteriwa ntsena laha u pfumeleriweke naswona swi pfumelelana ni nawu wa xihundla ni wa vatirhi. Ku languteriwa vutivi bya VANHU HINKWAVO ntsena — ku nga ri ti-akhawunti ta xihundla. Leswi kumekaka swa hlamuseleka, swi na ku tiyiseka ni laha swi humaka kona, swi xixima nkarhi wo hlayisa lowu nga hansi, swi lawuriwa hi ku fikelela naswona swi kamberiwa hi ku helela, naswona a swi tshami swi tirhisiwa eka swiboho swa ntirho leswi tiendlaka.
employee_reputation_settings.consent_required: Lava mpfumelelo / mpfumelelo wa mutirhi ku nga si languteriwa
employee_reputation_settings.consent_hint: Ku languteriwa vutivi bya vanhu hinkwavo ntsena — ku nga ri ti-akhawunti ta xihundla. Nkambelo wa munhu wa laveka ku nga si va ni xiendlo.
employee_reputation_settings.score_drop: Tsundzuxa loko tinhlayo ti hunguteka hi
employee_reputation_settings.negative_spike: Tsundzuxa hi mavonelo yo biha eka kumbe ehansi ka
employee_reputation_settings.auto_reports: Endla hi ku tisungulela swiviko swa vulavisisi bya AI (ku kamberiwa hi munhu) eka switsundzuxo leswikulu

recruitment_screening_show.title: Ku hlungiwa ka vakomberi hi AI
recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_title: Ku kamberiwa hi munhu — a hi xiboho xa ku thola lexi tiendlaka
recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_body: Swikombiso leswi swi endliweke hi AI i mpfuno wa xiboho ntsena naswona a swi fanelanga swi fambisa ku thola kumbe ku ala loku tiendlaka. Ku fana ka vito a hi vumbhoni bya vunhu. Kambela vumbhoni hi woxe naswona u nyika mukomberi nkarhi wa ku nyika mongo u nga si endla xiboho.
recruitment_screening_show.confirm_rescreen: Tirha ku hlungiwa ka AI ka mukomberi loyi nakambe? Leswi swi xopaxopa vukona bya vona bya vutshila bya vanhu hinkwavo ku kamberiwa hi munhu ntsena.
recruitment_screening_show.empty_title: A ku na ku hlungiwa loku endliweke
recruitment_screening_show.empty_body: A ku na ku hlungiwa ka AI loku endliweke ka mukomberi loyi. Tirha kun'we ku humesa swikombiso swa vutshila swa vanhu hinkwavo ku kamberiwa.
recruitment_screening_show.empty_no_consent: Mukomberi loyi a nga nyikangi mpfumelelo wa ku tirhisiwa ka AI, hikwalaho ku hlungiwa a ku nge tirhiwi.
recruitment_screening_show.status_skipped_no_consent: Ku hlungiwa ku tluriwile hikuva mukomberi a nga nyikangi mpfumelelo wa ku tirhisiwa ka AI.
recruitment_screening_show.no_summary: A ku na nkomiso lowu endliweke.
recruitment_screening_show.context_note: Mongo (a hi xiboho xa ku thola)
recruitment_screening_show.no_findings: A ku na leswi kumekeke swa vanhu hinkwavo leswi humesiweke.

factories.title: Tifeme
factories.subtitle: Tindhawu ta ntirho, tindzawulo na tilayini ta vumaki
